chapter.verse: Mari leh a sanggamnu Martha omna Bethani khua-ah Lazaras kici mi khat cina-in a om hi.
Cinapa Lazaras’ sanggamnu Mari in Zeisu’ khe sathau nuh a, a sam tawh a nulsaknu hi.
Tua hi a, a sanggamnute in Zeisu kiangah mi sawl uh a, “Topa aw, na itpa cina-in a om hi,” ci-in a ko uh hi.
Zeisu in tua thu a zak ciangin, “Hih cinatna in sih nading natna ahi kei hi. Pasian’minthan’ nading leh Pasian’ Tapa’ minthan’na a kilah nading hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in Martha, a sanggamnu leh Lazaras a it hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Lazaras’ cinat thu a zak ciangin pai loin ama omna munah ni nih a om lai hi.
Tua nung ciangin, “Tu-in Judah gam lamah pai kik ni,” ci-in a nungzuite kiangah a gen hi.
A nungzuite in, “Rabbi aw, Judah mite in tu nangawnin nang suang tawh deen’ dingin hong zong uh ahih ciangin, tua lam pai kik ding na hi hiam? a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Nisuah leh nitum kikal nai sawm leh nai nih pha hilo ahi hiam? Mi khat in sun lai takin a pai leh, leitung khuavak a muh maninah a kipuk thei kei ding hi.
Ahih hangin mi khat in khuamial lai takin a pai leh, ama sungah khuavak om lo ahih ciangin a puk thei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua thu amah in gen a, tua nung ciangin Zeisu in, “I lawmpa Lazaras ihmu-in a om hi. A phong dingin ka pai ding hi,” a ci hi.
A nungzuite in, “Topa aw, a ihmut leh, a nuamtuam ding hi,” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in Lazaras’ sihna thu a gen hangin a ihmu taktak a cihna bangin a nungzuite in a ngaihsun uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Zeisu in, “Lazaras a si zo hi,
note in na up nadingun tuasan takah om lo ka hih ciangin ka lungdam hi. Ahih hangin tu-in ama kiangah va pai ni,” ci-in a tel gen hi.
Didimas kici Thomas in nungzui a lawmte kiangah, “Ei zong Topa tawh sihna thuakkhawm dingin pai ni,” a ci hi.
Zeisu a tun’ ciangin Lazaras han sungah ni li a pha zo hi ci-in a thei hi.
Bethani khua in Jerusalem khua tawh tai nih dektak a kigamla hi.
Martha leh Mari’ sanggampa si ahih ciangin, a hehnem dingin Judah mite tampi a hong pai uh hi.
Zeisu hong paina thu Martha in a zak ciangin a dawn dingin a pai hi. Mari ahih leh, inn sungah tu-in a om lai hi.
Martha in, “Topa aw, nang om lecin ka sanggampa a si kei ding hi.
Tu nangawnin Pasian kiangah na nget khempeuh Pasian in hong pia ding cih ka thei hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Na sanggampa a thokik ding hi,” a cih ciangin
Martha in, “Ni tawp Ni-a thawhkikna-ah a thokik ding cih ka thei hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Keimah in thawhkikna leh nuntakna ka hi hi. Kei hong umte in a sih hangin a nungtakik ding hi.
Kei hong um a nungtate in zong cikmah ciangin a si ngei kei ding hi. Hih thu na um hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin,
amah in, “Ka um hi, Topa aw, Leitungah hong pai ding Pasian’ Tapa Khazih na hih ka um hi,” a ci hi.
Tua bang a cih khit ciangin Martha ciah a, a sanggamnu kiangah, “Sia hong tung zo a, nang hong sam hi,” ci-in a ko sim hi.
Tua thu a zak ciangin Mari thakhatin tho a, Zeisu va dawn hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu khua sungah a lut nai kei hi; Martha’ dawnna munah a om lai hi.
Tua ciangin dahna hehnem dinga inn sungah Mari tawh a omkhawm Judah mite in, amah tho meengmeenga a paikhiat a muh uh ciangin, amah kap dingin hanah a pai ding hi ci-in a nung a zui uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, Mari in Zeisu omna munah tung a, Topa a muh ciangin a khe mai-ah bokin, “Topa aw, nang om lecin ka sanggampa a si kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Mari akipan amah tawh hong paikhawm Judah mite a kap uh Zeisu in a muh ciangin, a sin sungah khuisa-a lungmangin,
“Koiah, na vui uh hiam?” ci-in a dot leh, “Topa, hong pai in la, hong en in,” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu a kap hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Judah mite in, “En un, amah in bangzah takin Lazaras a it hiam!” a ci uh hi.
Amaute lakah mi kimkhatte in, “Mittawpa khua a musak thei hih pa in hih mi zong a sih loh nadingin bawl thei lo ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Zeisu in a sungah khuisa kawmin hanah a pai hi. Tua han in leihawm hi a, suang tawh a kisin hi.
Zeisu in, “Suang lemkhia un,” a ci hi. Misipa’ sanggamnu Martha in, “Topa aw, tu-in ahih leh, a uih zo ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, ni li pha zo hi,” a cih leh,
Zeisu in, “Nang na up leh, Pasian’ minthan’na na mu ding hi, hong ci zo hilo ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amau in suang a lemkhia uh hi. Zeisu dakto a, “Pa aw, nang in keima thu hong ngai na hih ciangin na hehpihna ka phat hi.
Nang in keima thu nong ngai niloh cih ke’n ka thei hi. Ahih hangin kei na hong sawl ka hih hong um mihonpite in a up nadingun, amau ading tua thu ka gen hi,” a ci hi.
Tua bang a cih khit ciangin, “Lazaras aw, hong paikhia in,” ci-in nakpi-in a kiko hi.
A sipa in a khut a khe han puan tawh kitun a, a maitang dial tawh kitunin a paikhia hi. Zeisu in, “Amah phel un la, na khahkhia un,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Mari kiangah hong pai Judah mi tampite in Zeisu’ bawlna a muh uh ciangin a um uh hi.
Ahih hangin kimkhat ahih leh, Farisaite kiangah a pai uh a, Zeisu bawlna thu khempeuh a zasak uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin siampi liante leh Farisaite in upa vaihawmte kikhawmsak uh a, “Eite in bangci hih ding i hi hiam? Hih mi in nalamdang tampi a lak hi.
Hih mi i koihkhong leh, mite khempeuh in amah a um ding uh a, Rom mite hong pai-in eite omna gam ahi zongin, eite pawl ahi zongin hong susia ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Amau lakah mi khat, tua kum siampi ukpa ahi Kai-afas in, “Note in bangmah na thei kei uh hi.
Mi tampi tangding mi khat hong sih leh, Judah mite a kisiat sangin a pha zaw ci-in ngaihsun lo na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua bang a cihna in ama ut thu gen ahi kei hi. Tua kumin amah siampi ukpa ahih ciangin, Zeisu in mite tangding a si ding tham loin,
mun khempeuh ah a kikhenthang Pasian’ tate a kikhawm kiksak dingin a si ding hi,” ci-in kamsangpa bangin a gen hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua ni-a kipan Zeisu a thah nadingun amaute kikumin a vaihawm uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Judah mite lakah a kilangin Zeisu a pai nawn kei hi. Tua mun panin paikhia-in, gammang tawh kinai Efraim kici khua-ah pai a, a nungzuite tawh a omkhawm hi.
Judah mite’ Paisan pawikham ding nai a, mi tampi in a kisian’thosak nadingun Paisan pawi ma-in gam khempeuh panin Jerusalem khua-ah a paito uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, tuate in Zeisu zong uh a, “Bangci na ngaihsun uh hiam? Amah pawikhamna sungah hong pai lo ding hi ci-in na um uh hiam?” ci-in biakna innpi sungah ding-in a kidong uh hi.
Siampi liante leh Farisaite in Zeisu’ omna mun a thei a om leh, amaute in a mat theih nadingun hong hilh ta hen, ci-in tua lai takin lai a hawm uh hi.
